task: Discover the helper leaking input through short-circuit expressions, repair it and deliver a sink-free preview.

oracle: Independent CPython observations and AST byte spans; finite runtime cases for evaluation order and raises; cached/clean agreement, checked delivery, independent patch replay and reversal.
acceptance: Skip unreachable operands and preserve ordered, at-most-once operand evaluation.
Keep normal and exceptional alternatives through short-circuit calls and recursion.
Bind a versioned expression-control contract to native reports and typed SDK readers.
Reject unsupported evaluated expressions, exhausted budgets, stale reviews and tampered contracts.
Compare ordinary AST discovery and fr discovery through checked repair, feature delivery and receiver replay.
claims: Finite deterministic scalar corpus; no live-agent, token-saving, feasible-path, overloaded-protocol or source-equivalence claim.
authoring: Existing Rust and Python function bodies use reviewed fr previews and history applications. New declarations, fixtures, tests, metadata and documentation use direct edits.
